Materials Management

Track perishable materials and their clearance lifecycle.

materials

Perishable materials and clearance lifecycle API router.

This module provides JWT-authenticated endpoints for managing perishable material lots and monitoring personnel clearance lifecycle status.

Endpoints

Perishable Material Lots

  • POST / — Create a new material lot record.

  • GET / — List material lots with optional filtering by status, material type, or part number.

  • GET /{id} — Get a single material lot by ID.

  • PUT /{id} — Update a material lot (e.g., reassign to a different task).

  • DELETE /{id} — Delete a material lot (only if not yet thawed).

Thaw / Out-Time Telemetry

  • POST /{id}/thaw — Log a thaw event, transitioning the lot to THAWED_IN_USE.

  • POST /{id}/return-to-storage — Log return to cold storage, adding out-time hours to the accumulated total.

  • POST /{id}/consume — Mark a lot as fully consumed.

  • GET /{id}/status — Get detailed lot status with shelf-life remaining and out-time remaining.

Clearance Lifecycle

  • GET /clearance/{user_id}/status — Get a user’s clearance status (type, expiry, days remaining).

Access Control

All endpoints require JWT authentication via the get_current_user dependency. Only active users can create or modify material lots.
